title: Caretaker Tom Lewis collapses during drilling as the 1.6 GHz signal appears

tellings.quote: Our caretaker ends up being brought to his knees,
When Dragon is immediately act evacuating
tellings.difference: Calls it a cardiac episode, says Dragon evacuated him at once, and does not name the caretaker or mention the 1.6 GHz signal.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the ranch caretaker collapsing during a recent experiment on the mesa and being taken off the ranch.

as_told.title: Caretaker evacuated after cardiac episode during experiment

plain: Brandon Fugal, who owns a property called Skinwalker Ranch, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about something he says happened around 2025 or 2026 while his team was drilling below a flat-topped hill on the ranch. He says that as a radio signal at 1.6 gigahertz showed up, the ranch caretaker, Tom Lewis, was brought to his knees. In another part of the same episode the incident is described as a heart episode, and someone called Dragon is said to have evacuated him immediately; that version does not name the caretaker or mention the signal. Both tellings come from the same interview, so in effect this is Fugal's own account told twice. He tells it because, in his view, it ties the strange signal under the ranch to real harm to people.
